policies.sentence: Relying on AI for homework leaves students unprepared and hurts their performance on exams.
AI tools are not available on quizzes and exams, which students must solve without external materials.
Students should not rely on AI tools, because exams are closed-book.
Homework problems are practice for proctored quizzes that students take without help.
In a previous semester, students flagged for AI use scored lower.
